Pair Sum Frequency Counter

Problem Statement
A financial analytics system records daily transaction amounts.

The system wants to analyze how many unique pairs of transactions sum to a given target value.

Your task is to determine the total number of valid pairs such that:
arr[i] + arr[j] = target

Where:
i < j
Each pair must be counted only once.

The solution must be implemented efficiently using a HashMap to store frequencies of numbers.

Input Format
First line contains an integer N — number of transactions.

Second line contains N space-separated integers representing transaction amounts.

Third line contains an integer Target.

Output Format
Print a single integer — the number of valid pairs whose sum equals the target value.
